response.rationale: Both name the same capability: monitoring rink ice conditions. The labels are nearly identical; "Rink ice condition monitoring" and "Ice condition monitoring" differ only by the word "Rink". Both are also anchored on the same class, IceStateRepository (node 347150d64b7d1da9). A sees the capability from community:1, which also contains IceMonitorService, the domain-layer service that holds the business logic. B sees it from component:persistence, where only IceStateRepository relates to ice. The rest of that component is unrelated repositories and clients (members, bookings, payments). So B is the storage side of the same capability, not a different one. I'm not fully certain because B rests on a single repository, and that could be read as a separate "ice state persistence" concern.
